title: Sage dialogue_topic record
description: A dialogue_topic record (TopicRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another dialogue_topic record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

keyword.description: The word the player picks; empty = the id's name. May be a raw @key, resolved where it is shown. (string, default "")

known.description: Every listener knows it from the start (Morrowind's 'latest rumors') (bool, default false)

infos.description: The answers, in order: the first whose requires holds is the one given. (List<TopicInfo>)

requires.description: When this is the answer: one condition (use all for several), asked about the listener, with the speaker as the other; none = always. (ICondition)

then.description: What giving this answer does: the listener is the subject, the speaker the other. (List<IAction>)

then+.description: Adds to "then": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

then-.description: Removes these from "then" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

text.description: What the speaker says. May be a raw @key, resolved where it is shown. (string)
